definitions.explanation: A mimetic word representing the harsh, rasping sound of labored breathing, whether from physical exertion or a respiratory condition like asthma.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}ったら→上る：21460_noboru⟧、ぜいぜい⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: After climbing the stairs, I started wheezing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひいて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぜいぜい⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: Since catching a cold, my chest has been wheezing and I haven't been able to sleep well at night.

notes:
An onomatopoeic word (giongo) that mimics the sound of labored, wheezy breathing. It represents a harsh, rasping sound in the throat or chest.

USAGE:
- ぜいぜい(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to breathe wheezily
- ぜいぜい⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to wheeze (literally "to say zeizei")
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぜいぜい⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: one's chest wheezes
- Can describe both temporary breathlessness (from exercise) and chronic conditions (asthma)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぜいぜい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to breathe with wheezing
- ぜいぜい⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to wheeze
- ⟦{喘息|ぜんそく}→喘息：08444_zensoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぜいぜい⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wheeze from asthma
- ぜいぜいし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run while wheezing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- はあはあ: panting, heavy breathing — from exertion, not necessarily wheezy
- ぜえぜえ: variant of ぜいぜい; essentially the same meaning
- ひゅうひゅう: whistling sound of wind or breathing through a narrow passage
